sloka: आधिराज्ये ऽभिषेको मे ब्राह्मणैः पतिना सह ।कृतान्तकुशलैरुक्तं तत्सर्वं वितथीकृतम् ।। ६.४८.१४ ।।।।
transliteration: ādhirājye 'bhiṣeko me brāhmaṇaiḥ patinā saha ।kṛtāntakuśalairuktaṁ tatsarvaṁ vitathīkṛtam ।। 6.48.14 ।।।।

translations.english: "The prediction of astrologers that I will be consecrated with my husband and all that is falsified."
